change_log.rationale: The staged calibration surface now derives close-open gap candidates internally from raw boundary observations so callers no longer perform mechanical preprocessing outside Janiform.
change_log.summary: Replace staged close-open gap candidate inputs with raw boundary observations and explicit detection policy.

change_log.rationale: Calibration now exposes a market-data-first request boundary with explicit provenance and normalization selections while keeping staged execution as the advanced path.
change_log.summary: Add the market-data calibration request contract and recommended CLI entry point.

change_log.rationale: The market-data-first calibration surface now exposes a public preparation result with diagnostics and provenance, plus a direct market-data runner, so examples and tooling can stay on the user-facing path instead of dropping to staged orchestration.
change_log.summary: Add public market-data preparation and run entrypoints with surfaced diagnostics.

change_log.rationale: The split calibration package now exposes its public namespace through package re-exports without rewriting symbol origin metadata, so introspection reflects the defining submodules.
change_log.summary: Record calibration package re-exports without module-origin shims.

change_log.rationale: The coarse-interval runner is now a public simulation workflow, so the Python contract snapshot must include the new simulation request and path artifacts instead of leaving the workflow behind private native bindings.
change_log.summary: Add the public coarse-interval simulation surface under janiform.simulation.

change_log.rationale: The simulation surface now lives in a package with private submodules, so public imports stay stable while API introspection records the defining submodule for shared contracts and workflow types.
change_log.summary: Record janiform.simulation package-backed re-exports without module-origin shims.

change_log.rationale: The public Python contracts now treat signed trade labels as the canonical Hawkes calibration input and expose seeded simulation as a priced fine path with derived event replay, so the approved snapshot must match the new design-faithful workflow surface.
change_log.summary: Record the signed-trade calibration surface and canonical seeded priced fine path.

change_log.rationale: The guardrail now snapshots stringified callable annotations so Linux and Windows produce the same approved public API signature records even when annotation evaluation availability differs between environments.
change_log.summary: Normalize public API guardrail signatures for cross-platform snapshot stability.

change_log.rationale: Hawkes calibration now accepts unsigned directional-label diagnostics and an observed source regime instead of caller-supplied raw objective terms, so the public calibration contracts must expose the new regime and diagnostics models and the updated candidate constructor.
change_log.summary: Replace public Hawkes candidate objective terms with unsigned-regime diagnostics.
